title: Dynamics 365 Finance: ERP Analytics MCP gives agents access to Business performance analytics data
summary: Hold: the briefing calls the default unstated even though the roadmap says it is enabled automatically for admins, makers and marketers. It also understates potential agent consumption costs and omits licence-based exceptions from the separate ERP MCP server's billing description. The analytics capabilities, prerequisites and BPA security paths are documented.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: No licence, meter or price specific to the ERP Analytics MCP server is published in the documentation checked.
claims.quote: Searched: "ERP Analytics MCP" license licensing pricing credits meter. Read Analytics overview, technical details, FAQ, Copilot Studio guide, BPA overview and separate ERP MCP licensing; no Analytics-specific server rate found.

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The known cost is low, meaning indirect admin time only, because no server-specific meter is published.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage. You calculate the total cost based on the sum of the Copilot Credits your organization uses.
claims.fix: Set cost to variable. Replace the cost rationale with 'Variable. Copilot Studio agents can consume Copilot Credits, although qualifying authenticated employee-facing usage by Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users is included. No Analytics MCP server-specific execution rate is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management and add the same distinction to Cost and licensing; retain the narrower absence of an Analytics-specific server meter.

claims.claim: Using the separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server in Copilot Studio incurs the Copilot Studio rate.
claims.quote: Business to Employee usage of Copilot Studio agents is included in the Copilot USL when the user of that agent is licensed with Copilot and the agent operates by using the authenticated Copilot USL user's identity.
claims.fix: Qualify the separate-server sentence: 'For the separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server, Copilot Studio ordinarily bills at its Agent Action rate, but authenticated Business-to-Employee usage by a Copilot USL licensed user is included and does not incur additional tool-call credit consumption.' Keep this explicitly separate from Analytics MCP server execution pricing.

claims.claim: The separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server costs 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call on other clients.
claims.quote: The following premium licenses are exempt from the tool execution billing for agents built on clients other than Copilot Studio.
claims.fix: Replace that rate clause with 'On other clients, the separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server charges 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call for standard user licences; Dynamics 365 Finance Premium and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Premium are exempt from that execution charge.'

claims.claim: The default state is unknown because no source states what happens on arrival.
claims.quote: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically
claims.fix: Set defaultState to on under the schema's automatic-enablement definition.
